header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: bearers of the Arsh, Your angels and all Your creation witnesses” — whoever says these Kalimahs once in the morning or in the evening, Allah Ta'ala frees a quarter of his body from Jahannam. If anyone recites them twice, Allah Ta'ala frees half of his body from the Fire of Jahannam. Whoever says them three times, Allah Ta'ala frees three quarters of his body from the Fire of Jahannam. Whoever recites them four times, Allah Ta'ala frees his entire body from the Fire of Jahannam”, Rasulullah ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ لِفَاطِمَةَ ﵂: مَا يَمْنَعُكِ أَنْ تَسْمَعِي مَا أُوصِيكِ بِهِ أَنْ تَقُولِي إِذَا أَصْبَحْتِ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتِ: يَاحَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَي نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقَالَ: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط الشيخين ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٥٤٥/١
blocks.tamil_translation: .”Listen carefully to my advice! In the morning and in the evening, keep reciting the Du'a يَاحَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي( )كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَي نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ ‘O Ever-Living! O Sustainer of the heavens, the earth and all creation! By Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs! Do not leave me to my own self even for the blink of an eye!’” — so the Prophet ﷺ said to Hazrat Fatimah (RA), narrates Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ:
